entities.summary: Brian Habib is an American former professional football player who played offensive lineman for 11 seasons for the Minnesota Vikings, Denver Broncos, and Seattle Seahawks. He was selected by the Vikings in the tenth round of the 1988 NFL draft. With the Broncos, he won Super Bowl XXXII.
